metadata.question: Does Asir, Saudi Arabia show higher NDVI in June 2016 and  2017, compared with the long-term average for that period from 2003–2011?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Asir, Saudi Arabia (need to define a geometry for this region) - Time periods: June 2016-2017 vs June 2003-2011 (long-term average) - Collection: MODIS NDVI (MOD13A2 or MOD13Q1) for long-term consistency, or Landsat/Sentinel-2 2. Masking strategy: - NDVI comparison, so need to mask clouds and invalid pixels - Use QA bands for MODIS or cloud masking for Landsat/Sentinel-2 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NDVI for June 2016-2017 - Calculate mean NDVI for June 2003-2011 - Compare: if 2016-2017 > 2003-2011, answer A; else B - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid calculation) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Asir region in Saudi Arabia (approximate center) const asir = ee.Geometry.Point([42.5, 18.2]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer // 2. Data Acquisition using MODIS NDVI const modis = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD13A2') .select('NDVI') .filterBounds(asir); // Long-term period: June 2003-2011 const longTermCol = modis .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2003, 2011, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')); // Recent period: June 2016-2017 const recentCol = modis .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2016, 2017, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month')); const longTermSize = longTermCol.size().getInfo(); const recentSize = recentCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Long-term images (2003-2011): ${longTermSize}`); console.log(`Recent images (2016-2017): ${recentSize}`); if (longTermSize === 0 || recentSize === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI const longTermMean = longTermCol.mean().multiply(0.0001); // MODIS NDVI scale factor const recentMean = recentCol.mean().multiply(0.0001); // 4. Calculate statistics const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const longTermStats = longTermMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: asir, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const recentStats = recentMean.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: asir, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const longTermNDVI = longTermStats.NDVI_mean; const longTermCount = longTermStats.NDVI_count; const recentNDVI = recentStats.NDVI_mean; const recentCount = recentStats.NDVI_count; console.log(`Long-term (2003-2011) NDVI: ${longTermNDVI?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${longTermCount}`); console.log(`Recent (2016-2017) NDVI: ${recentNDVI?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${recentCount}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (longTermCount === 0 || recentCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (longTermNDVI == null || recentNDVI == null || isNaN(longTermNDVI) || isNaN(recentNDVI) || longTermNDVI < -1 || longTermNDVI > 1 || recentNDVI < -1 || recentNDVI > 1) { console.log("Invalid NDVI calculation."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (recentNDVI > longTermNDVI) { console.log(`Higher NDVI in 2016-2017 (${recentNDVI.toFixed(4)}) vs 2003-2011 (${longTermNDVI.toFixed(4)})`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Not higher: 2016-2017 (${recentNDVI.toFixed(4)}) vs 2003-2011 (${longTermNDVI.toFixed(4)})`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
